objective: Select or reject a BF16-visible recurrent RWKV controller over the material projected-KV carrier before any hybrid training or native benchmark run.

motivation.accepted_carrier: The projected-KV-slot V9 system has a signed native benchmark gain.
motivation.recurrent_only_failure: The fresh recurrent-only path mutated state, received finite nonzero gradients in all 42 layers, and updated weights, but produced exactly zero BF16 final-logit delta after one update.
motivation.architectural_response: Keep projected slots as the retrieval carrier and expose recurrent RWKV state only through a bounded residual or gate that is exactly identity when recurrent state is zero.

architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: For every candidate, hybrid(projected_read, zero_rwkv_read) equals projected_read exactly.

causal_conditions.projected_only: Correct-row projected keys, values, occupancy, and surprise with recurrent readout bypassed.
causal_conditions.hybrid_correct: Correct-row projected bundle plus correct-row recurrent matrix, position, and previous-source bundle.
causal_conditions.hybrid_zero_recurrent: Correct-row projected bundle held byte-identical while every recurrent tensor is zeroed.
causal_conditions.hybrid_matched_donor_recurrent: Correct-row projected bundle held byte-identical while the complete recurrent bundle comes from the locked different-gold, write-length-matched donor.
causal_conditions.prohibited_confound: Projected keys, values, occupancy, surprise, base weights, and adapter weights may not change between conditions.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient synchronization or optimizer update in this architecture screen
execution.generation: teacher-forced final-logit materiality on the native read sequence

selection_rule: Among candidates passing every gate on every rank, select the lowest hybrid_gain; within that gain select the smallest worst-rank correct-versus-projected maximum absolute logit delta; break exact ties by candidate_id.

stopping_rule.pass: A selected candidate authorizes only a separately locked one-update BF16 gradient/materiality calibration. It does not authorize the native benchmark or any protected split.
stopping_rule.failure: If no candidate passes, archive the failure and redesign the carrier-controller interface before training.
stopping_rule.always: Archive, commit, and push the complete result.

claim_policy.screen_pass: May claim only that a fixed projected carrier has a BF16-visible incremental dependence on recurrent RWKV state under fresh initialization.
claim_policy.screen_failure: Must report that none of the bounded hybrid equations made RWKV state materially visible under this screen.
claim_policy.native_gain: Forbidden without later matched training, open native evaluation, and correct/zero/donor/layer-permuted controls.
